import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def calculate(df, params):
    # 参数设置，默认值基于M30周期及区域统计特征推导
    trend_period = params.get("trend_period", 20)      # 趋势判断周期
    breakout_period = params.get("breakout_period", 10) # 突破回看周期
    atr_period = params.get("atr_period", 14)           # ATR计算周期
    vol_spike_thresh = params.get("vol_spike_thresh", 2.0) # 波动率突增阈值(倍数)
    momentum_thresh = params.get("momentum_thresh", 0.001) # 最小动量阈值(0.1%)
    
    o = df['open']
    h = df['high']
    l = df['low']
    c = df['close']
    v = df['volume']
    
    # 1. 基础指标计算
    # 简单移动平均作为趋势基准
    ma = c.rolling(window=trend_period).mean()
    
    # 真实波幅 (TR) 与 ATR
    tr1 = h - l
    tr2 = (h - c.shift(1)).abs()
    tr3 = (l - c.shift(1)).abs()
    tr = pd.concat([tr1, tr2, tr3], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    atr = tr.rolling(window=atr_period).mean()
    
    # 近期高低点通道
    hh = h.rolling(window=breakout_period).max()
    ll = l.rolling(window=breakout_period).min()
    
    # 价格动量 (收益率)
    ret = c.pct_change()
    
    # 2. 信号生成逻辑
    
    # --- 多头入场 ---
    # 条件：价格在均线上方 + 突破近期高点 + 动量为正
    # 使用 shift(1) 确保信号基于上一根K线完成的数据
    long_cond = (c.shift(1) > ma.shift(1)) & \
                (c.shift(1) > hh.shift(2)) & \
                (ret.shift(1) > momentum_thresh)
    
    # --- 空头入场 ---
    # 条件：价格在均线下方 + 跌破近期低点 + 动量为负
    short_cond = (c.shift(1) < ma.shift(1)) & \
                 (c.shift(1) < ll.shift(2)) & \
                 (ret.shift(1) < -momentum_thresh)
    
    entry = pd.Series(0.0, index=df.index)
    entry[long_cond] = 1.0
    entry[short_cond] = -1.0
    
    # --- 出场逻辑 (波动率衰竭/反转) ---
    # 逻辑：当前ATR显著高于历史均值(波动率突增)，且价格出现滞涨或反转形态
    # 多头平仓：持有中，波动率突增，且收盘价低于开盘价(阴线)或留下长上影
    upper_shadow = h - np.maximum(o, c)
    body = (c - o).abs()
    
    # 波动率突增检测
    atr_mean = atr.rolling(window=trend_period*2).mean()
    vol_spike = atr > (atr_mean * vol_spike_thresh)
    
    # 多头持仓时的平仓信号：波动率突增 + (收阴 或 上影线大于实体)
    exit_long_cond = (entry.shift(1).cumsum() > 0) & vol_spike.shift(1) & \
                     ((c.shift(1) < o.shift(1)) | (upper_shadow.shift(1) > body.shift(1)))
                     
    # 空头持仓时的平仓信号：波动率突增 + (收阳 或 下影线大于实体)
    lower_shadow = np.minimum(o, c) - l
    exit_short_cond = (entry.shift(1).cumsum() < 0) & vol_spike.shift(1) & \
                      ((c.shift(1) > o.shift(1)) | (lower_shadow.shift(1) > body.shift(1)))

    # 简化出场逻辑：如果不追踪持仓状态，仅基于形态给出反向信号或止盈信号
    # 这里采用更通用的“反转/衰竭”信号作为出场建议
    exit_signal = pd.Series(0.0, index=df.index)
    
    # 多头衰竭出场 (对应图中右侧高点后的快速下跌)
    # 条件：之前是上升趋势(价格在MA上)，当前波动率放大，且价格大幅回落
    long_exhaustion = (c.shift(2) > ma.shift(2)) & vol_spike.shift(1) & (ret.shift(1) < -momentum_thresh * 2)
    
    # 空头衰竭出场
    short_exhaustion = (c.shift(2) < ma.shift(2)) & vol_spike.shift(1) & (ret.shift(1) > momentum_thresh * 2)
    
    exit_signal[long_exhaustion] = 1.0  # 平多
    exit_signal[short_exhaustion] = -1.0 # 平空
    
    return {"entry": entry, "exit": exit_signal}

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def calculate(df, params):
    fast = params.get("fast_period", 5)
    slow = params.get("slow_period", 20)
    vol_ma = params.get("vol_period", 10)
    atr_n = params.get("atr_period", 14)
    
    c = df["close"]
    h = df["high"]
    l = df["low"]
    v = df["volume"]
    
    ma_f = c.rolling(fast).mean()
    ma_s = c.rolling(slow).mean()
    v_ma = v.rolling(vol_ma).mean()
    
    tr = pd.concat([h - l, (h - c.shift(1)).abs(), (l - c.shift(1)).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    atr = tr.rolling(atr_n).mean()
    
    prev_ma_f = ma_f.shift(1)
    prev_ma_s = ma_s.shift(1)
    prev_c = c.shift(1)
    prev_v = v.shift(1)
    prev_atr = atr.shift(1)
    
    bull_cross = (prev_ma_f <= prev_ma_s) & (ma_f > ma_s)
    bear_cross = (prev_ma_f >= prev_ma_s) & (ma_f < ma_s)
    
    mom_up = c > prev_c
    mom_dn = c < prev_c
    
    vol_exp = prev_v > v_ma.shift(1) * params.get("vol_mult", 1.2)
    valid_atr = prev_atr > 0
    
    long_sig = bull_cross & mom_up & vol_exp & valid_atr
    short_sig = bear_cross & mom_dn & vol_exp & valid_atr
    
    entry = pd.Series(0.0, index=df.index)
    entry[long_sig] = 1.0
    entry[short_sig] = -1.0
    
    exit_long = (c.shift(1) < ma_s.shift(1)) & (entry.shift(1) == 1.0)
    exit_short = (c.shift(1) > ma_s.shift(1)) & (entry.shift(1) == -1.0)
    
    exit = pd.Series(0.0, index=df.index)
    exit[exit_long] = 1.0
    exit[exit_short] = -1.0
    
    return {"entry": entry.fillna(0.0), "exit": exit.fillna(0.0)}

def calculate(df, params):
    """
    基于订单失败特征生成的镜像反转因子。
    
    原始订单分析：
    - 方向：Short (做空)
    - 结果：亏损 (-3280.0)
    - 峰值利润：645.0 (入场后短暂盈利)
    - 谷值亏损：-3280.0 (最终大幅回撤)
    - 入场价：4373.61，出场价：4406.41 (价格上涨导致空单亏损)
    
    优化逻辑：
    1. 既然原策略在上涨趋势中做空失败，且出现了“先盈后巨亏”的特征，说明市场动能强劲向上。
    2. 镜像因子应转为做多（Long）。
    3. 止损止盈参数需镜像调整，但考虑到原策略是逆势交易导致的巨大亏损，新策略顺势交易通常风险收益比更优。
       这里保持ATR倍数的对称性，但方向反转。
    """
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    
    # 计算 ATR (Average True Range)
    high_low = df['high'] - df['low']
    high_close = (df['high'] - df['close'].shift(1)).abs()
    low_close = (df['low'] - df['close'].shift(1)).abs()
    
    true_range = pd.concat([high_low, high_close, low_close], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    atr = true_range.rolling(window=params.get('atr_window', 14)).mean()
    
    # 定义信号：当价格突破近期高点或动量强劲时做多
    # 这里使用简单的动量突破逻辑作为示例因子生成
    # 因子值为正表示建议做多（与原做空相反）
    
    # 计算短期和长期均线斜率以捕捉趋势
    sma_short = df['close'].rolling(window=5).mean()
    sma_long = df['close'].rolling(window=20).mean()
    
    # 动量因子：收盘价相对于均线的偏离度
    momentum = (df['close'] - sma_long) / atr
    
    # 结合成交量确认
    volume_ma = df['volume'].rolling(window=10).mean()
    volume_ratio = df['volume'] / volume_ma
    
    # 综合因子：高动量 + 放量 + 价格在均线上方
    # 如果原策略做空失败，我们寻找做多的机会
    signal = np.where(
        (momentum > 0) & 
        (volume_ratio > 1.2) & 
        (df['close'] > sma_short), 
        1.0,  # 强烈看多信号
        np.where(
            (momentum < 0) & 
            (volume_ratio > 1.2) & 
            (df['close'] < sma_short), 
            -1.0, # 强烈看空信号
            0.0   # 中性
        )
    )
    
    return signal

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def calculate(df, params):
    # 参数定义：基于震荡区间与中轴突破逻辑
    range_period = params.get("range_period", 20)
    volume_ratio = params.get("volume_ratio", 1.5)
    
    # 计算近期波动率与区间范围
    high_window = df['high'].rolling(range_period).max()
    low_window = df['low'].rolling(range_period).min()
    range_val = high_window - low_window
    
    # 动态中枢（区间中轴）
    mid_point = (high_window + low_window) / 2.0
    
    # 当前K线相对于中枢的位置归一化 (-1: 底部, 0: 中轴, 1: 顶部)
    normalized_pos = (df['close'] - low_window) / range_val.replace(0, 1)
    
    # 成交量放大倍数
    vol_ma = df['volume'].rolling(10).mean()
    vol_spike = df['volume'] > (vol_ma * volume_ratio)
    
    # 入场逻辑：价格触及极端位置（>0.8 或 <0.2）且伴随放量
    # 多头：触及底部区域(<0.2)且放量
    long_signal = (normalized_pos < 0.2) & vol_spike
    # 空头：触及顶部区域(>0.8)且放量
    short_signal = (normalized_pos > 0.8) & vol_spike
    
    entry = pd.Series(0.0, index=df.index)
    entry[long_signal] = 1.0
    entry[short_signal] = -1.0
    
    # 离场逻辑：价格回归中枢附近（|pos - 0.5| < 0.15）
    mean_reversion = (np.abs(normalized_pos - 0.5) < 0.15)
    
    exit_long = entry.shift(1) == 1.0  # 前一根K线是多头持仓
    exit_short = entry.shift(1) == -1.0 # 前一根K线是空头持仓
    
    exit = pd.Series(0.0, index=df.index)
    exit[(exit_long) & mean_reversion] = 1.0
    exit[(exit_short) & mean_reversion] = -1.0
    
    return {"entry": entry, "exit": exit}
